brief: Refine iteration 2 (human rejected iter 1: must say Webex and show the repo's tool categories) - README hero for webex-messaging-mcp-server

generations.prompt_sent: subject: isometric marketing hero illustration for a developer tool, with a bold clean sans-serif headline reading exactly "Webex MCP Server" and a small sub-badge reading exactly "52 TOOLS" in the upper third, above a central glowing hexagonal hub labeled exactly "MCP" that connects a luminous AI assistant robot orb on the left to six tidy labeled service modules fanned out on the right, each a rounded isometric card with an icon and a caption: a chat-bubble card labeled "Messages", a meeting-space card labeled "Rooms", a group card labeled "Teams", a person card labeled "People", a lightning-bolt card labeled "Webhooks", a building card labeled "Enterprise"; action: luminous data packets flowing along curved glowing pipelines from the AI orb through the MCP hub outward into every labeled module card; location: dark navy abstract digital plane with a subtle receding grid horizon; camera_control: three-quarter isometric aerial view, wide 16:9 framing, headline text centered in the upper negative space; lighting: cool teal and emerald rim light with soft cyan glows against a deep navy background, gentle volumetric haze; style: premium SaaS marketing hero art, clean vector-inspired 3D render, minimal and uncluttered, crisp perfectly-spelled legible typography, the ONLY words in the image are: Webex MCP Server, 52 TOOLS, MCP, Messages, Rooms, Teams, People, Webhooks, Enterprise; no other text, no company logos, no watermarks

evals.feedback: Big improvement on the human's feedback: crisp, correctly-spelled 'Webex MCP Server' headline, '52 TOOLS' badge, 'MCP' hub label, and labeled tool-category cards make the repo's purpose explicit. Typography is clean throughout with zero garbling. Defect that forces refine: the six module cards are not the six requested categories - 'Messages' appears twice (top-right and bottom-left cards) and 'Rooms' is missing entirely. For a README hero enumerating the server's tool categories, a duplicated category and a missing one is a factual error, not a cosmetic one.
evals.prompt_patch: Emphasize EXACTLY six unique cards, each label used exactly once: Messages, Rooms, Teams, People, Webhooks, Enterprise; give Rooms a distinct meeting-room/door icon; explicitly forbid repeating any label.
